newsitem.title: USA: DIGITRAN SAYS COURT DISMISSES CH. 11 FILING.
newsitem.headline: DIGITRAN SAYS COURT DISMISSES CH. 11 FILING.

text.p: Digitran Systems Inc said Thursday a Utah bankruptcy judge dismissed the company's Chapter 11 filing, which it said it took up as protection against a class action shareholder suit.
A preliminary settlement with the class action plaintiffs was reached on May 22.
A Federal District Court Judge gave his approval of the settlement agreement on July 18, the company said in a statement.
Digitran said a final hearing on the settlement will be heard in Federal District Court in Salt Lake City, Utah on Sept 4.
The company said the settlement calls for it to pay $600,000 to shareholders and $400,000 to compensate attorneys for their costs.
